hooks.text: One neighboring star is sprinting across our sky faster than any other.
Every 180 years, one nearby star crosses the Moon's entire width.
The fastest moving star in our sky is completely invisible to human eyes.

title: The Fastest Moving Star in Our Sky
description: Barnard's Star is racing across our night sky faster than any other known star. Meet the neighboring red dwarf that hid real worlds for over fifty years.

beats.text: One neighboring star is sprinting across our sky faster than any other.
beats.visual: Hubble Space Telescope view of Barnard's Star against deep background stars, 2005

beats.text: In 1916, astronomer Edward Emerson Barnard found this star crosses the width of the full Moon every 180 years.
beats.visual: Portrait of astronomer Edward Emerson Barnard at the Yerkes Observatory, 1910

beats.text: Located roughly six light-years away, it is our closest neighbor after the Alpha Centauri system.
beats.visual: Map of the nearest star systems within ten light-years of the Sun, 2014

beats.text: Yet despite its proximity, this red dwarf is too dim to see with the unaided eye.
beats.visual: Artist's impression of a red dwarf star in deep space, ESO, 2012
queries: Red dwarf star artist impression ESO

beats.text: It is blueshifted and racing straight toward our Sun at roughly 110 kilometers per second.
beats.visual: Artist's impression of Barnard's Star with its radial velocity indicated, ESO, 2018

beats.text: For over half a century, astronomers announced giant planets around it, only to debunk them as telescope errors.
beats.visual: Photograph of astronomer Peter van de Kamp at the Sproul Observatory telescope, 1965

beats.text: Astronomers finally confirmed genuine exoplanets orbiting the star in 2024 and 2025.
beats.visual: Artist's impression of confirmed exoplanets orbiting Barnard's Star, ESO, 2024

beats.text: Those worlds are locked into a high-speed sprint with a star racing through deep space.
beats.visual: Artist's illustration of planets orbiting a red dwarf star, NASA, 2023

better_than_last: Reduced hook length to exactly 12 words and improved the looping transition by echoing the sprint imagery in the final beat.
